title.en: Recurrence without revision of the selector

statement.en: A declared process has a state that returns after two steps and changes at every step while its operative selector stays the same at every time: recurrence can go on with the selector unrevised, so learning or revision of the selector is a further claim.
statement.zh: 一个所声明的过程有一个状态，两步后返回、每一步都改变，而其运作的选择者在每个时刻都相同：复现可在选择者未经修订时持续，所以学习或选择者的修订是另一主张。

laws.en: Every state returns to itself after two steps; every state whose selector selects alternation changes at the step; changing only the selector, at a common phase, changes the next phase, so the selector is operative; every step keeps the selector, so it is the same at every time.
laws.zh: 每个状态两步后回到自身；选择者选择交替的每个状态在这一步改变；在相同相位下只改变选择者便改变下一相位，所以选择者在运作；每一步保持选择者，所以它在每个时刻都相同。

laws.en: Witness: the state at phase false selecting alternation returns after two steps, changes at the first and keeps its selector at every time; every later state selects alternation too, so it changes at every step.
laws.zh: 见证：相位为假、选择交替的状态两步后返回，第一步改变，选择者在每个时刻保持；其后每个状态也选择交替，所以每一步都改变。

hypotheses.en: One declared two-phase process with a Boolean selector and a supplied transition: one value selects alternation, the other holding the phase; steps in order.
hypotheses.zh: 一个所声明的两相过程，带布尔选择者与所给的转移：一个值选择交替，另一个值保持相位；步骤依次进行。

hypotheses.en: No axiom: the checked bytes gave every FixedSelector theorem an empty axiom report (Lean 4.29.1 with Std); a module before the spine, not on the pure core.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理：所检查的字节使 FixedSelector 的每条定理公理报告为空（Lean 4.29.1 与 Std）；脊柱之前的模块，不在纯核心上。

does_not_show.en: That learning or selector revision never comes with recurrence: a richer process can learn.
does_not_show.zh: 学习或选择者修订从不伴随复现：更丰富的过程可以学习。

does_not_show.en: A definition or classification of every kind of learning.
does_not_show.zh: 对每种学习的定义或分类。

validation_scope.en: The repository checker with Lean 4.29.1 passed BoundaryModels on 6 October 2026 (lean/verification.json, the checked bytes kept in its run folder), every FixedSelector theorem with an empty axiom report. On 16 October a comment was added to the file's first line, so no passing receipt binds the current bytes and the record is reviewed, not receipt-bound, until a checker run does. Reviewed in LEAN-CORE-REVIEW, whose first finding had the selector made operative and whose reinspection accepted the non-implication; no person's review recorded.
validation_scope.zh: 仓库检查器以 Lean 4.29.1 于2026年10月6日通过 BoundaryModels（lean/verification.json，所检查字节存于其运行目录），FixedSelector 每条定理公理报告为空。10月16日文件首行加了注释，故无通过的回执绑定当前字节；在检查器重跑之前本记录为已审而非回执绑定。经 LEAN-CORE-REVIEW 审查：其首项发现促使选择者改为运作，复查接受此非蕴含；未经人审。

next_delta.en: A checker run binding the current bytes; the non-implication restated on the spine as an instance of the gate laws, the selector being a quantity every step keeps.
next_delta.zh: 重跑检查器以绑定当前字节；在脊柱上把此非蕴含重述为门之诸律的实例，选择者是每一步都保持之量。

correspondence.en: In Ashby's (1952, Design for a Brain) terms the selector is a parameter that the step-mechanisms of an ultrastable system would change; here none does, and the system still cycles. Both readings, of the selector as such a parameter and of periodic behaviour as no evidence of adaptation without a change of rule, are the AI's.
correspondence.zh: 按 Ashby（1952，Design for a Brain）的说法，选择者是超稳定系统的阶跃机制会改变的参数；此处无一改变它，系统仍循环。把选择者读作此种参数，以及无规则之改变则周期行为不是适应之证据，两种读法皆是 AI 的。

aliases: Recurrence without revision of the selector

detail.en: A quantity every step keeps is kept along every course; the selector is such a quantity while the phase recurs.
detail.zh: 每一步都保持之量沿每条进程都被保持；选择者即此种量，而相位复现。

history.zh: 2026年10月27日：新增（DF2），选择者不修订的复现：一个两步后返回、每步改变而运作的选择者每刻相同的过程；因无通过的回执绑定该文件当前字节，状态为已审定范围；出自 DEFECTS-FOUND（分诊第 148 行与第 113 行）；研究第 426 节。
